limits: The full1822-test suite was executed once in this stage; the orchestration reuses its exact same-stage TRX only after matching all code, test, fixture and embedded data inputs plus Core DLL.
This slice implements scoped own-unit Move/Hold/Recall; per-directive explicit original retry/cancel controls remain the next slice, and old role-specific controls cannot operate on the new role.

Only these27 GPU processes were rerun: four directive/partial-old-recall-cancel cases, wing reply loss/recovery, old moving cancellation, held recall retry, group/historical entry, legacy military/combat, ground material and three smokes. Other prior GPU scenarios were not rerun.
80m perception,120m local exercise range and600second default delivery deadline remain trial coefficients, not nationwide acceptance.
12second fixed60fps recording contains actual selected-unit movement plus chronological saved-state cuts, not a real-time performance benchmark.

visual_review.method: Actual current-run left/right/main/cancellation stills and five decoded video frames inspected with view_image. Controls fit and terrain is nonblank. Physical receipt and player knowledge remain separate; main/wing outside80m shows dated past observation rather than actual home position. Partial old army cancellation preserves newer main-post hold. Dense camp labels are still prototype quality. Video contains actual moving selected wing plus chronological saved-state cuts, not performance measurement.
